scope: Exact owner-selected deep dossier enrichment for the published Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation organization, with priority attention to LEUNR and no autonomous publication.

prospects.name: Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation
prospects.fitSummary: Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation lets a reviewer test whether LEUNR's historical 0.1 MWth design and funded TRL 4/5-to-6, unfuelled, manufacturing and monitoring work support a real next conversation; oecd-nea.org, CSA, ERA and the federal corporate registry separate progress from licensing, fuel, deployment and continuity limits.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed CSMC's current official identity, subsidiaries, LEUNR expansion, stated 2029 demonstration target and public contact route.
Recovered the historical 0.1 MWth, 130 C, pressurized light-water and fuel design basis plus licensing, siting and fuel-supply limits.
Confirmed federal incorporation, Active status, name history, current ISC control and the time-sensitive overdue-filing and intent-to-dissolve warning.
Located a pending lunar and planetary reactor patent family but did not treat it as proof of the current LEUNR configuration, construction or performance.
Resolved CSA, DND, NRC and DIANA public agreements, including exact dates, amounts, identifiers and the unfuelled or early-stage maturity boundaries.
Confirmed no reported parent company, named subsidiary beneficiaries and disclosed federal funding without converting lobbying activity into customer demand.
Resolved Telesat, ERA, University of Alberta, NGen and NATO counterpart evidence while preserving MOU, unfuelled and development-stage limits.
Captured the supplied CEO interview as attributed timeline and design context, then excluded unsupported performance, deployment, fuel-supply and manufacturing claims.
Checked French Open Government and bilingual federal surfaces; they confirmed existing program scope but produced no additional decision-changing field.
Final CNSC, CNL, fuel-supplier, transport and customer searches found no public licence, siting record, qualified fuel agreement, deployment order or additional candidate field.
